summary: EcoTrack-IA is a proposed AI-driven system aimed at helping small businesses reduce their carbon footprint by providing analytics, recommendations, and tracking tools.
assumptions: Small businesses are motivated to reduce their environmental impact
AI can effectively analyze operational data to identify carbon reduction opportunities
There is sufficient data available from small businesses for AI analysis
Small businesses have the technical capacity or willingness to adopt such a system
There exists a market willing to pay for carbon reduction solutions
gaps: Clear articulation of the problem being solved
Concrete description of the solution features and workflow
Defined business model and revenue streams
Identified constraints such as data availability, regulatory issues, or budget limits
